content.comment_body: Hi, I'm trying to send a command to read 5 word variable memory locations, but my [product_name] is not responding. Other commands, like (0x55 0x13 0x13 0x00 0x00 0x55), work fine but reading VM does not. Here's my code for reading VM: public class read_vm { public static void main(String[] args){ int Counter = 5; int Checksum = 0; int ReadDataLength = 3+1+3*Counter+2+1; int ReadData[] = new int[ReadDataLength]; int Address[] = new int[Counter]; Address[0]=18; Address[1]=20; Address[2]=22; Address[3]=24; Address[4]=26; ReadData[0]=0x55; ReadData[1]=0x1E; ReadData[2]=0x1E; ReadData[3]=Counter; int index=3; for(int i=0; i<Counter; i++){ int VMAddr=Address[i]; int VMLength=2; index++; ReadData[index]=VMAddr&0xff; index++; ReadData[index]=VMAddr>>8&0xff; index++; ReadData[index]=VMLength; Checksum += VMLength<<10+VMAddr; } index++; ReadData[index]=Checksum&0xff; index++; ReadData[index]=Checksum>>8&0xff; index++; ReadData[index]=0xAA; for(int i=0;i<index+1;i++){ System.out.println(ReadData[i]); // send to [product_name] } } }

Hello [user_name], You seem to be proficient in Java. Could you share your read_byte_from_logo function? What response bytes do you receive from your [product_name]? Do you get 0x06 initially? 0x06 means your data has been acknowledged, but if you receive 0x15, it's not acknowledged. Thank you! Before sending my request, I send a "STATE_REQ": 0x55 0x17 0x17 0xAA. If my [product_name] responds with 0x06 0x01, I send my request, and the read VM works.

Hello, To read bytes, you must send 0x05 (PC_READ_BYTES = 5). Try this sample code: [code] import java.io.IOException; import java.io.InputStream; import java.io.OutputStream; import java.net.InetAddress; import java.net.InetSocketAddress; import java.net.Socket; import java.net.UnknownHostException; public class testReadLogo { static InputStream inputStream = null; static OutputStream outputStream = null; public static void main(String[] args){ Socket socket = new Socket(); String logoIPAddress = "198.0.0.1"; // Use your [product_name] IP address int logoSocketNr = 10001; InetAddress destinationIP = null; int connectionTimeout = 5000; long logoReadTimeout = 2001L; try { System.out.println("Connecting ... 1"); destinationIP = InetAddress.getByName(logoIPAddress); System.out.println("Connecting ... 2"); socket.connect(new InetSocketAddress(destinationIP, logoSocketNr), connectionTimeout); System.out.println("Connecting ... 3"); inputStream = socket.getInputStream(); outputStream = socket.getOutputStream(); System.out.println("Connection OK"); // Send request to read bytes outputStream.write(5); // PC_READ_BYTES = 5 int[] readValue1 = readInternalByte(2, logoReadTimeout); // Expect ACK = 6 int i = 0; for (int value : readValue1) { System.out.println("Message: " + (i+1) + " = " + readValue1[i]); i++; } // If ACK = 6 received // Send memory address 18 outputStream.write(0); // High address outputStream.write(18); // Low address outputStream.write(0); // Count start outputStream.write(5); // Count int[] readValue2 = readInternalByte(5, logoReadTimeout); // Expect ACK = 6 i = 0; for (int value : readValue2) { System.out.println("Message: " + (i+1) + " = " + readValue2[i]); i++; } socket.close(); } catch (UnknownHostException e) { System.out.println("UnknownHostException: " + e.getMessage()); } catch (IOException e) { System.out.println("IOException: " + e.getMessage()); } } public static int[] readInternalByte(int readLength, long readTimeOut) throws IOException { int readCounter = 0; int[] readResult = new int[readLength]; int i = 0; while (i < readLength) { readResult[i] = -1; i++; } long time1 = System.currentTimeMillis(); for (long time2 = time1; time2 - time1 < readTimeOut; ) { byte[] telegramBuffer = new byte[1024]; time2 = System.currentTimeMillis(); if (inputStream == null) { continue; } inputStream.read(telegramBuffer); for(int value : telegramBuffer){ if (value > 0 && readCounter < readLength) { readResult[readCounter] = value; readCounter++; } } if (readCounter > 0){ break; } if (readCounter >= readLength || (time2 - time1) > readTimeOut) { break; } } return readResult; } } [/code]
